visual_thesis: A recommendation should carry definitions, quality and lineage through an access boundary. At 320px see context grounded above a review threshold; full size follow three distinct evidence relationships without treating vendor claims as verified outcomes.
mechanism_metaphor: A single continuous vertical provenance cross-section, not a tree of decorative scenery. At top three interlocked metadata facets display a glossary leaf, a quality-inspection aperture and a lineage strand. Fine nondirectional ties show which data specimen each facet describes. The middle is a large open context assembly with a policy boundary at its lower opening and an identity tab outside it. Exactly two arrows: governed context exits into the recommendation specimen only within policy; the recommendation proceeds to a human-review threshold at bottom-right. The boundary stops an unauthorized branch with a blunt end, no arrowhead. Fifteen useful parts: glossary term leaf, definition association, data specimen, quality aperture, quality association, lineage origin, lineage transformation joint, lineage tie, access boundary, identity tab, audit-trace strip, context exit port, recommendation specimen, review threshold and detached vendor-evidence caveat. No faces, hands, shield or approval stamp.

All glyph extents at least 40px inside final edges, preferably 72px.

Only the enumerated arrowheads are allowed; each must begin and end on an illustrated physical port outside every text box. All described comparison ties and brackets are nondirectional and have NO arrowheads. Detached caveat never has a connector.

No people, humanoids, faces, logos, photography, product gloss, shields, gears, control knobs, dashboards, generic cards, scenery or unsupported chart marks. Crisp professional linework, meaningful internal stages and strong silhouette with breathing room.
